title: Stage Hom equation from coherent object triangles
statement: Given the coherent comparison objects of lem-pc-affine-model-coherent-object-comparisons, the stage conjugated Hom equation of def-pc-affine-model-comparison-data holds for every chain map on the two scalar-extended models. This is only the stage-arrow portion of the argument; the other arrows and the construction of the object comparisons are not conclusions. The maps are scalarExtensionHom [def-pc-complex-scalar-extension-hom] and perfectStageMap/perfectLimitMap [lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport].

source.place: The explicit formula of def-pc-affine-model-comparison-data and the canonical termwise tilde definition; definitional constructor step.

proof.text: Fix j, k and the chain map a. Use the proved local stageMap_asHomMap equation to express perfectStageMap using affineModelStageArrow. Use homMap_pinned to express perfectHomMap through an equal pinned comparison. This pin is Classical.choose of the fully proved assertion that there is an isomorphism equal to the supplied comparison; pinnedIso_eq proves that exact equality. Rewrite the two supplied object triangles by the same equality. Apply the proved affineModel_scalarConjugation_nat to the ring maps F(j), F(j→k), F(k), their F.map_comp equality, the localized tilde functors, m.θ(j,k), the object comparisons and the two rewritten triangles. This lemma identifies scalarExtensionHom with scalar reassociation and uses naturality and inverse cancellation to give precisely the desired conjugated Hom equality. All local helpers are proved; there are no new mathematical hypotheses or postponed steps.

proof_origin.place: U2: the original scalar-reassociation and naturality argument, using the proved affineModel_scalarConjugation_nat API and exact-value local transport equations; derived pullback composition is as in Tag 0D5S.
